items.desc: Assisted in teaching Information Systems Design Analysis, introducing students to system analysis and design concepts.
Served as a speaker in a visual editing training session, sharing practical knowledge and techniques in visual editing.

Explored UI/UX design through application interface design, user requirement documentation (URS), and infographic development. Gained experience working with professional workflows, SOPs, and cross-functional collaboration.
Assisted in multimedia learning activities, covering video editing, photo editing, and 3D rendering.
Contributed to the organization's digital media production, primarily working as a video editor for Himakom's YouTube channel.
Started my undergraduate journey in Computer Science, beginning a path of learning, exploring, and figuring things out.
